rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for inventing or devising an idea, method, or plan.

example.english: I finally contrive a simple way to solve this problem.
example.traditional: 我終於諗出一個簡單方法，解決呢個問題。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zung1 jyu1 nam2 ceot1 jat1 go3 gaan2 daan1 fong1 faat3 gaai2 kyut3 ni1 go3 man6 tai4

rows.note: Use this when the devised solution or scheme is clever, unconventional, or slightly crafty.

example.english: They contrive a crafty way to hide the documents in the false ceiling.
example.traditional: 佢為咗避開檢查，度橋將啲文件藏喺假天花入面。
example.jyutping: keoi5 wai6 zo2 bei6 hoi1 gim2 caa4 dok6 kiu2 zoeng1 di1 man4 gin6 cong4 hai2 gaa2 tin1 faa1 jap6 min6
